paragraphs: Ahavah, son of Rabbi Zeira, end of Rosh Hashanah 29a; Nedarim 32a. He was in Caesarea. Rabbi Zeira spoke to his son Ahavah, Rosh Hashanah 30b. Rava said, “Because Ahavah son of Rabbi Zeira taught it, should one hang ornaments on it?”, Eruvin 96, end of b. Eikhah Rabbah, on “The Lord has done what He purposed”: son of Rabbi Ze'ira. Tanchuma, Noach: Achva bar Ze'ira; likewise Chazit on “Solomon had a vineyard,” Bereshit Rabbah, section 84, and Midrash Kohelet on “He made everything beautiful in its time” and “I returned and saw under the sun”: Rabbi Achvah son of Rabbi Zeira. Beginning of Lekh Lekha, section 39: Rabbi Achuyah in Rabbi Ze'ira’s name—a scribal error. Beginning of Challah: Rabbi Mana said, “I went to Caesarea and heard Rabbi Achvah in Rabbi Ze'ira’s name”—an error; it should read son of Rabbi Ze'ira. The same subject in Jerusalem Talmud, Kol Sha'ah, has son of Rabbi Ze'ira. Sedeh Yehoshua’s errata at the beginning of Challah say to read Rabbi Acha bar Ze'ira, since Rabbi Acha bar Ze'ira occurs in the Babylonian Talmud. I found only Ahavah bar Zeira or Ze'ira.
